title: James Harden Aims for Hall of Fame Career in Business After Basketball
htmlContent:
James Harden, who is one of the NBA's most prolific players, recently discussed his career on and off the court on the Earn Your Leisure podcast. Harden is already preparing for his post-basketball future, despite his athletic success being the main focus of many fans. He expressed his aspirations to have a Hall of Fame career outside of the court, focusing on business and building relationships that will carry him into the next phase of his life. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i3ioK835EdE
Harden shared, "I want to have a Hall of Fame career after basketball as well, so just making sure the relationships are in place to where once it’s over, I can say thank you basketball, I appreciate you, I love you so much, but now it's time to get it on."
Although the NBA star has always been dedicated to excellence on the basketball court, his mindset is now shifting towards establishing the foundation for future success in business. He considered Kobe Bryant's influence on his transition from basketball to business, resulting in his success as an entrepreneur, investor, and storyteller. Harden referenced Bryant as a model of how athletes can thrive beyond sports.
"That’s another thing where Kobe was so happy with what he did. He wasn’t trying to go back and play again. He was like, 'Thank you basketball, it’s time to get the money off the court.' That’s how I kind of want to be."
Harden's focus is not only on his playing days coming to an end, but also on being prepared to transition to the next stage of his career with a solid foundation when the time comes.
"I want to be done, appreciate everything, and then figure out the business side," he explained. However, he’s not under any illusions about how difficult that transition will be. "It’s going to be 10 times harder than basketball, but I think I’ll be prepared for it when it’s time."
Harden's approach to business is similar to his approach to basketball: it requires dedication, strategic thinking, and strong relationships. He's establishing himself as someone who is preparing for the future beyond the basketball court. By establishing significant connections with industry leaders and exploring investments and ventures that will serve him once his playing days are over. As Harden continues to dominate on the court, it's evident that he has a clear vision for a Hall of Fame career beyond basketball. His path, influenced by figures like Kobe Bryant, will be one where hard work, preparation, and relationships will lead to success beyond sports.
